Chapter 12. Domestic Relations

§ 12.345 Dissolution of marriage.

(1) A marriage is dissolved by a judgment of dissolution entered by the family division of the circuit court.

(2) A proceeding in which the parties dispute custody, parenting time, or property remains a dissolution of marriage under this section and is governed by this chapter.

(3) Nothing in this section limits the court's authority to enter temporary orders under § 12.348.

Current through 2026 Exampleland Act 12; published September 1, 2026.

History: 2019 Act 4; 2026 Act 12.
